title: thelaia rotundifolia
intro: Thelaia rotundifolia, commonly known as a medicinal plant, is a species of flowering plant in the family Asteraceae. It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, and is used to treat various conditions such as fever, digestive issues, and respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of Thelaia rotundifolia are attributed to its ability to reduce inflammation, improve digestion, and boost the immune system, making it a popular natural remedy in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
